feats.name: Versatile Techniques
feats.description: Your mastery of multiple weapon styles allows you to adapt to any combat situation. You can use your bonus action to switch between weapon types, gaining advantage on attack rolls with the new weapon for the rest of your turn.

effects.notes: Switch weapons and gain advantage on attacks for the turn

feats.name: Tactical Superiority
feats.description: Your understanding of weapon tactics allows you to exploit weaknesses in your enemies' defenses. You can use your action to analyze an opponent's fighting style, gaining advantage on attack rolls against them for the next minute.

effects.notes: Gain advantage on attacks against analyzed opponent for 1 minute

feats.name: Weapon Specialization
feats.description: Your expertise with specific weapon types has reached new heights. Choose two weapon types. You have advantage on attack rolls with these weapons, and you can use your reaction to make an additional attack with one of these weapons when you hit.

effects.notes: Advantage on attacks with two specialized weapon types
Make additional attack with specialized weapon on hit

feats.name: Master of Arms
feats.description: Your mastery of weapons has become legendary. You can use your action to enter a state of perfect weapon control, gaining advantage on all weapon attack rolls and the ability to use any weapon as if you were proficient with it for the next minute.

effects.notes: Gain advantage on all weapon attacks and proficiency with any weapon for 1 minute

feats.name: Legendary Weapon Master
feats.description: Your weapon mastery has reached the pinnacle of martial achievement. Once per long rest, you can use your action to perform a legendary weapon demonstration, making up to four weapon attacks with advantage, each dealing additional damage equal to your Fighter level.

effects.notes: Once per long rest, make four weapon attacks with advantage and bonus damage
